Evidence / 来源

The slider reveals a stored field; it does not run a new solver or a new inference. Statistics use the full segment, omit the initial frame for RMSE, and use data rounded to 4 decimals for display. The selected case and seed are fixed, not chosen for low error. Temperature fields are 1-D space × time, not a measured 2-D plate surface.

滑块展示保存的场数据，不触发新仿真或新推理。统计覆盖完整换热段，RMSE 排除初始帧；页面数据保留四位小数。固定工况和种子未按误差挑选。温度图的两个维度为空间与时间，并非二维板面测量。
